posts.body:
My brother is bringing back his family to HK to visit, and they have 10 month old twins. I'm desperately looking for 2 cots I could borrow for 2 weeks in mid October. Does anyone have a cot that they aren't using right now which I could borrow?

Any suggestions on do's and don'ts for carting round 10 month olds in a side-by-side baby stroller in HK, and places which we could take them that the kids would like? (I'm going to get the guide to where you can go with strollers)

posts.body:
I read in the List magazine this week that The Hong Kong YWCA (3/F 1 MacDonnell Road Central Tel: 34761340) has a range of baby equipment for short term hire - strollers, car seats, portable cots, high chairs. 

Hope that helps
